_comment: Single source of truth for the upstream vercel/chat checkout used by scripts/verify_test_fidelity.py and .github/workflows/lint.yml. 'pin' is the strict CI tag (must share major.minor with UPSTREAM_PARITY in src/chat_sdk/__init__.py); 'target' is the sync-wave tag that --report-target measures against. Record full commit SHAs from `git rev-parse <tag>^{commit}`. Only the pin-bump PR changes 'pin'.
